notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Eternal Witness.
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
